radius.$description: The chart tooltip (3310:177953). The KPI tooltip (2184:242826) keeps Preline's 4 px default; one radius serves both.

max-width.$description: Figma's tooltips are one line; longer text wraps at this width.

gap.$description: Between a chart tooltip's lines (Preline Overlays/Tooltips/Gap Between).

offset.$description: From the anchor to the body: the KPI tooltip sits 11 px from its info icon, its beak's tip about 1.5 px from it.

arrow-width.$description: The beak (Figma Top and Bottom Beak): a sharp triangle 18.2 wide and 10.8 tall, its base 1.25 px inside the body, so 9.5 px of it shows.

arrow-inset.$description: How far the beak's base sits inside the body, so no seam shows between them.

delay.$description: How long the pointer rests on the anchor before the tooltip opens: today's MUI tooltips' 100 ms. Focus opens it at once.

edge.$description: The pale lime 2 px edge inside the modal (Figma: lime 100 fading to lime 50).

action-width.$description: The destructive dialog's Cancel and Delete share one width.

confirm-width.$description: The confirming primary button (Start Round, Change Password).

illustration-size.$description: Figma's drawing on the round's interstitial (2546:398410), 24 above its words.

width.$description: The interstitial's column; a narrower screen wraps the words.

ink.$description: The drawing's outlines and dark fills, as Figma draws them.

accent.$description: The drawing's blue (the hair and the lightbulb), as Figma draws it.

width.$description: Dropdown panel (Frame 38717): the first level of the Sort and Filter menus; a submenu hugs its labels.

offset.$description: A menu opens 12 px below its trigger, and a submenu 12 px beside its menu, top to top with the row that opened it.

parent-item-height.$description: A row that opens a submenu: a 46 px highlight inset 4 px at the sides, 2 px above the next row, as the sidebar's items.

parent-item-width.$description: Its highlight is 178 wide, which makes the first level 210.

option-gap.$description: Between the options of a select's list (the Select Event list); the dropdown menu's items are 4 apart.

list-max-height.$description: A long list to type into stops at about eight options, the next one cut to show there are more.

radius.$description: Preline Alert (Soft, Rounded), inline and in toasts.

toast.$description: The Figma toasts (measured on the Admin and player screens): a soft fill, 12 px corners, no shadow, a 16/24 message 20 px after the icon, centred on the window near its bottom. The Admin shows the Preline soft alert; the player a bolder pill with the icon in a ringed circle.

padding-y-player.$description: Player: 8 above and below the ringed icon.

offset.$description: Above the bottom of the window (42 in the Admin frames, 30 in the player's).

max-width.$description: A toast hugs its message up to this width, then wraps.

ring-width.$description: The pale ring around the player's icon.

duration.$description: Figma note: alerts disappear after 2 seconds.

success-text.$description: The message on the success fill (4.9:1); the icon keeps success.soft-fg.

info-text.$description: Figma's customised blue 700 (7.1:1); the icon is the brand blue (fg.info).

warning-text.$description: Not in the Figma file (its warnings are red); 4.6:1 on the warning fill.

row-height-compact.$description: A compact table (a slide's, a dense list): 40 px rows, 12 px at the sides, 14/20 text.

radius.$description: The table's frame, which clips the header's top corners.

link-width.$description: The row's arrow: a 30 x 26 ghost button with the 14 px arrow 8 px from its left, 20 px into the last column.

link-shift.$description: How far a row's arrow moves right while the row is hovered.

scrollbar-track.$description: The Figma table's scrollbar (the macOS one): track, the line along its inner edge and the 8 px thumb.

radius.$description: The statement tables' frame (Figma Tables 904:131713): a gray 200 edge inside, clipped, the default drop shadow.

cell-padding-y.$description: A line of 16/24 and the 1 px rule fill the 44 px row, as Figma's; a label that wraps grows its row.

value-width.$description: Figma's figure columns; a narrower table narrows them to their figures.

label-min-width.$description: The labels' column never narrower than today's statements' 220; short of it the table scrolls sideways, the labels kept in view.

indent.$description: A line under a parent (Salary under Operating Expense) sits 20 further in per level, in italic.

gap-height.$description: The slate 200 band that parts a statement's groups (Figma's spacer row).

radius.$description: The initiative table's frame and its history's (Figma 2101:491037, 2101:486664): a gray 200 edge inside, clipped.

header-height.$description: The picker's header: Regular 14/20 with 12 above and below. The history's is 48, in SemiBold 16/24.

max-height.$description: The picker scrolls within Figma's 484, its header kept in view (today's 530).

min-width.$description: The picker's columns need today's 650: short of it the table scrolls sideways, and on a phone its rows stack.

check-width.$description: The check column: 16 before the 28 box and 8 after it.

chip-width.$description: The cost and energy chips, flat, stacked 10 apart.

history-column-width.$description: The history's round and date columns; the initiatives take the rest.

chosen-bg.$description: A chosen initiative's row, every cell of it (Figma 2107:219929); the box stays white.

plot-inset.$description: The top grid line's distance from the top of the plot: centred in the 24 px row of its label, as Figma draws it.

axis-gap.$description: Y labels to the plot, and the plot to the x labels (Preline Charts/Bar Chart/Spacing Between).

bar-max-width.$description: A bar is three tenths of its team's column (Figma: 25 px in 85), up to this on wide cards.

stack-max-width.$description: A stacked bar is two fifths of its team's column, up to this, so the values written inside it fit.

segment-min-height.$description: A stacked bar's segment shorter than its value's line (14/20) gives its value in the tooltip only.

legend-dot.$description: A series' dot in the legend (Figma _legend-indicator: 8 px, round).

legend-item-gap.$description: A series' dot to its name.

legend-offset.$description: From the chart to its legend under it.

legend-swatch-width.$description: A bar series' swatch in the legend over the plot (Figma's charge-offs, 5204:98482: 29 x 15).

plot-height-sm.$description: The plot of a chart beside the player's decisions (Figma's charge-offs, 5204:98482: 141 in its 294 card).

histogram-gap.$description: Between the combo chart's bars, which fill their columns (Figma: 2).

line-width.$description: A line series. Figma draws 1 px; 2 reads where the line crosses the bars.

point-size.$description: A point on a line series, in its colour inside a white edge (Figma's Pointer: 6 px).

horizontal-bar-gap.$description: Inside the axis lines, above and below each horizontal bar and between two (Figma: 16 above and below the Account bar).

row-label-width.$description: A horizontal bar's name, at its start, wraps within this: Figma's "Number of Accounts" on two lines.

donut-size.$description: The donut (Figma's Revenue Breakdown, 2193:396973: 141 across, its ring a quarter of that radius).

donut-gap.$description: Between two of the donut's segments, along the middle of its ring (Figma: about 5 degrees, 6 px there).

donut-legend-gap.$description: The donut to its legend beside it (Figma: 64).

donut-legend-row-gap.$description: Between the series of the legend beside the donut (Figma: 8).

heat.$description: A table value's place in its row, in today's revenue table's four bands (green, lime, orange, red), a shade lighter so the value reads on it.

high.$description: Near the top of its row: a score over 0.85.

low.$description: Near the bottom of its row.
